lines.en: label streets25:
scene yumiramenjob1
I manage to find Yumi wandering around the city and somehow coax her into grabbing fate by the balls today.
lines.zh: 我总算在城里找到了闲逛的 Yumi，还不知怎么哄着她今天去揪住命运的蛋蛋。

lines.en: After going back and forth for around twenty minutes or so, she finally caves and the two of us make our way to the old district to visit Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 来回磨了大概二十分钟，她终于松口，于是我们两个动身前往老城区去找 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : You sure you remember where this place is?
lines.zh: : 你确定记得那地方在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : It’s like the middle of fuckin’ nowhere out here.
lines.zh: : 这他妈简直就是鸟不拉屎的地方。

lines.en: : I thought you spent a lot of time in this part of town?
lines.zh: : 你不是经常泡在这一带吗？

lines.en: : Doesn’t mean I know where fuckin’ everything is, jackass.
lines.zh: : 那不代表我他妈什么都知道，蠢货。

lines.en: : This place is confusing as shit to navigate sometimes.
lines.zh: : 这地方有时候绕得人要死。

lines.en: : It’s easy to get lost. And it sucks when you do because of all the fuckin’ homeless people out here tryin’ to nab your spare change and shit.
lines.zh: : 很容易迷路。而且迷路了还特别惨，因为这一带的流浪汉他妈老想掏你口袋里的零钱什么的。

lines.en: : At least they haven’t bothered {i}us{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 至少他们还没来烦“{i}我们{/i}”。

lines.en: : Give it a minute or two, they’ll find you. Always fuckin’ do.
lines.zh: : 再等个一两分钟，他们就会找上你。他们他妈总能找到。

lines.en: We make our way down the street toward Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: 我们沿街朝 Tojo Ramen 走去。

lines.en: Thankfully, I do remember the way on account of coming here to see Tsuneyo, but it seems like Yumi is genuine when she says she doesn’t know where it is.
lines.zh: 幸好我还记得路，毕竟之前来找过 Tsuneyo，不过 Yumi 说她不知道地方，看起来是真话。

lines.en: She’s right in saying this part of town is easy to get lost in.
lines.zh: 她说这一带容易迷路，倒是没说错。

lines.en: It feels almost like a labyrinth at times.
lines.zh: 有时候简直像个迷宫。

lines.en: Abandoned building after abandoned building cloud the landscape while dwellings of impoverished living stack haphazardly on top of one another.
lines.zh: 废弃建筑一栋接一栋地糊满视野，而穷人的住处又乱七八糟地彼此叠在一起。

lines.en: Every once in a while, a stray cat will run past us. Some of them even stop and rub up against Yumi.
lines.zh: 偶尔会有流浪猫从我们身边跑过。有的甚至会停下来蹭 Yumi。

lines.en: She has no reaction.
lines.zh: 她毫无反应。

lines.en: She must truly be heartless.
lines.zh: 她一定真的没有心。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob2
: Thanks for coming...I guess.
lines.zh: : 谢了……大概吧。

lines.en: : Not because I’m nervous or anything. I just wouldn’t have been able to find the place on my own.
lines.zh: : 不是因为我紧张什么的。我只是自己找不到那地方。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like you have an interview scheduled or anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，反正你也没约好面试什么的。

lines.en: : You could pretty much come here whenever you want. No one’s expecting you.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候来都行。没人在等你。

lines.en: : Are you gonna fucking say “You’re welcome” or are you just gonna try and make me sound like an idiot?
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底是打算说句“不客气”，还是只想把我衬得像个白痴？

lines.en: : Feel like every time I try and say somethin’ nice, you just throw it back in my face.
lines.zh: : 感觉每次我想说点好话，你都把它甩回我脸上。

lines.en: : To be fair, you’ve only said two or three nice things to me since we’ve met.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我们认识以来你对我说过的好话也就两三句。

lines.en: : Yeah but those might be the only two or three nice things you ever get out of me, so it’s probably best if you don’t fuckin’ toss ‘em aside so easily.
lines.zh: : 可那也许是你这辈子能从我这儿听到的仅有的两三句好话，所以你最好别他妈这么随随便便就扔到一边。

lines.en: : You’re welcome, Yumi. I’m happy to have been of some sort of help to you today.
lines.zh: : 不客气，Yumi。今天能帮上你一点忙，我很高兴。

lines.en: : Even if it is only as a GPS.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是当个 GPS。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob1
: See? Was that so fucking hard?
lines.zh: : 你看？有那么难吗？

lines.en: The walk continues.
lines.zh: 路程继续。

lines.en: We weave our way through the streets in the second half of town and manage to dodge enough panhandlers to finally come close to our destination.
lines.zh: 我们在后半城的街巷里穿行，躲开足够多的乞讨者，总算接近了目的地。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob3
: So, I’m obviously not going to use your stupid strategy from the other night...but just for peace of mind, what was it again?
lines.zh: : 那么，我显然不会用你那天晚上那套蠢策略……不过为了安心起见，再说一遍是什么来着？

lines.en: : Just telling Tsuneyo how much you love noodles over and over.
lines.zh: : 就是一遍又一遍地跟 Tsuneyo 说你有多爱面条。

lines.en: : I honestly can’t imagine that {i}not{/i} working.
lines.zh: : 我真想不到那样会{i}“不”{/i}管用。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob4
: That’s so fucking weird...I don’t get it at all.
lines.zh: : 太他妈怪了……我一点都理解不了。

lines.en: : Neither do I. But hey, at least she knows her interests.
lines.zh: : 我也是。不过话说回来，至少她清楚自己的兴趣。

lines.en: : And besides, it’s a weird little shop in the middle of nowhere. If it had a normal interview process, it would lose its charm.
lines.zh: : 再说，那是一家开在鸟不拉屎的地方的小店。要是它的面试流程很正常，反倒没味道了。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob5
: There’s no charm in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 这种地方可没什么味道可言。

lines.en: : Just a bunch of fuck-ups and burnouts tryin’ to make it one more day without givin’ up on life.
lines.zh: : 只有一群失败者和废人，在努力再多撑一天不放弃人生。

lines.en: : Thing about places like this is that if you spend too much time in ‘em, they wind up drainin’ you.
lines.zh: : 这种地方的问题在于，你待得太久，它们就会把你榨干。

lines.en: : You lose any sense of hope...give up on your dreams and think shit like, “Somethin’ {i}that{/i} good won’t ever happen to me.”
lines.zh: : 你会失去所有希望……放弃梦想，开始觉得“{i}那么好{/i}的事才不会发生在我身上”。

lines.en: : It eats away at you.
lines.zh: : 它会一点点把你啃光。

lines.en: : And before you know it, you’re wakin’ up in an alley with a needle stickin’ out of your arm thinking, “How the fuck did it come to this?”
lines.zh: : 然后不知不觉间，你就醒在巷子里，胳膊上插着针头，心想“怎么他妈就变成这样了？”

lines.en: : I’m hoping you’ve never woken up like that.
lines.zh: : 我希望你从没那样醒过。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob6
: Me? Nahh.
lines.zh: : 我？没有啦。

lines.en: : Drugs are cheap, so I probably could, though.
lines.zh: : 毒品很便宜，所以我想嗑还是嗑得起的。

lines.en: : Hell, probably still might if things never wind up gettin’ any better.
lines.zh: : 操，要是日子一直好不起来，说不定哪天还是会嗑。

lines.en: : But I’ve seen how that shit works firsthand and it’s not pretty. So I’ve somehow managed to avoid it one way or another.
lines.zh: : 不过我亲眼见过那玩意儿的下场，一点都不好看。所以我好歹想办法躲开了。

lines.en: : Nothing’s ever certain, though. Desperation can make people do crazy shit.
lines.zh: : 但是谁也说不准。绝望能让人做出疯狂的事。

lines.en: : So who knows? Maybe one day, the reason I won’t be in[school] might be a lot worse than just me not wantin’ to show up.
lines.zh: : 所以谁知道呢？也许有一天，我不去[school]的理由，会比“我只是不想去”糟糕得多。

lines.en: For what might be the first time ever, I actually understand where Yumi’s coming from.
lines.zh: 大概是有生以来第一次，我真的理解 Yumi 是从什么样的处境里走出来的。

lines.en: I’m obviously a lot less experienced in the topic than she seems to be, but she’s smart enough to realize how dangerous a life like that is.
lines.zh: 我在这方面的经验显然远不如她，但她足够聪明，明白那种生活有多危险。

lines.en: And yet she chooses to walk that path, surviving solely off of thievery and handouts from her best friend.
lines.zh: 可她还是选择走在那条路上，只靠偷窃和闺蜜的接济活下去。

lines.en: But it’s not like that makes her weak.
lines.zh: 但这并不代表她软弱。

lines.en: Those are just the circumstances she’s found herself in.
lines.zh: 那只是她身处的环境罢了。

lines.en: Good for her.
lines.zh: 她很了不起了。

lines.en: : I’m proud of you.
lines.zh: : 我为你骄傲。

lines.en: : I just want you to know that.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你知道这一点。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob2
: Suck my dick, you fucking [rapist].
lines.zh: : 舔我的鸡巴去吧，你这个[rapist]。

lines.en: : Don’t try to act like my dad just because I opened up for a second.
lines.zh: : 别因为我敞开心扉了一秒就装得像我爸一样。

lines.en: : It’s just...a long walk and I’m fuckin’ bored.
lines.zh: : 只是……路太长，我他妈无聊罢了。

lines.en: : Are we there yet?
lines.zh: : 我们到了吗？

lines.en: : Just a few more blocks.
lines.zh: : 再过几个街区就到。

lines.en: scene black
And so we walk a few more blocks.
lines.zh: 于是我们又走了几个街区。

lines.en: The scent of pork broth hits us from a quarter mile away, which is actually quite surprising given that Tojo Ramen doesn’t have any windows for the scent to leak out of.
lines.zh: 猪骨汤的香味从四分之一英里外就扑了过来，考虑到 Tojo Ramen 连一扇能让味道漏出来的窗户都没有，这还挺让人惊讶的。

lines.en: I wonder why that is?
lines.zh: 为什么会这样呢？

lines.en: : Wait. Stop...
lines.zh: : 等等。停……

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob7
Yumi comes to a sudden halt just as we’re about to round the final corner to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: 就在我们即将拐过去到 Tojo Ramen 的最后一个转角时，Yumi 猛地停了下来。

lines.en: In front of us is the same woman who I wound up buying dinner for the first time I ever went there.
lines.zh: 我们面前站着的，正是我第一次去那儿时替她付了饭钱的那个女人。

lines.en: And I’m assuming she’s the reason Yumi is suddenly hesitating.
lines.zh: 而我想，Yumi 突然犹豫的原因就是她。

lines.en: : Uhh...Yeah, I don’t know if I’m feeling up to this today, dude.
lines.zh: : 呃……那个，我不知道我今天还有没有心情干这个，老兄。

lines.en: : My stomach hurts and I think I’m just gonna head back to Chika’s place and crash.
lines.zh: : 我肚子疼，我想我还是回 Chika 家躺一会儿吧。

lines.en: : But it’s right around the corner. We’ve been walking for hours.
lines.zh: : 可就在拐角处了。我们都走了好几个小时了。

lines.en: : At least give it a shot.
lines.zh: : 至少试一试吧。

lines.en: : Pass. I’ll give it a shot another day. I-
lines.zh: : 免了。改天再试。我——

lines.en: : If it’s because you’re worried about that girl over there, I know from experience that she’s not as bad as she looks.
lines.zh: : 如果是因为你在意那边那个女人，根据我的经验，她没看起来那么糟。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob8
: That’s my fucking mom, you idiot!
lines.zh: : 那他妈是我妈，你个白痴！

lines.en: : And what kind of experience do you have with her?!
lines.zh: : 你跟她能有什么经验？！

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is your mom?
lines.zh: : “{i}那{/i}”是你妈？

lines.en: : Yes!
: ...I bought her dinner once.
lines.zh: : ……我请她吃过一次饭。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob9
: Why did you buy dinner for my mom?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要请我妈吃饭？！

lines.en: : I didn’t know she was your mom.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她是你妈。

lines.en: : We have the same fucking eyes!
lines.zh: : 我们有一模一样的眼睛！

lines.en: : Besides, she {i}is{/i} as bad as she looks! And I have a lot more experience with her than you do, I can tell you that.
lines.zh: : 再说，她{i}“就是”{/i}有看起来那么糟！而且我跟她打交道的经验比你多得多，这点我可以肯定。

lines.en: : Who the fuck did you think I was talking about when I went on that rant about drugs and shit like ten minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 你以为我十分钟前那一通关于毒品什么的牢骚是在说谁？

lines.en: : She’s a fucking psycho. And who the fuck knows what will happen if she sees me here?
lines.zh: : 她就是个疯子。天知道她要是看见我在这儿会发生什么。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob10
: Ah-
Yumi’s apparent mother suddenly shifts her eyes in our direction and causes Yumi to flinch in response.
lines.zh: Yumi 那位疑似母亲突然把视线转向我们这边，Yumi 随之缩了一下。

lines.en: scene black
She grabs my wrist and forcefully pulls me into an alleyway right beside us, throwing her body up against mine and bringing her voice to a whisper.
lines.zh: 她一把抓住我的手腕，用力把我拽进旁边的一条小巷，整个人贴到我身上，把声音压成耳语。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob11
: If you even {i}think{/i} about touching me right now, I will fucking kill you.
lines.zh: : 你现在要是{i}“敢”{/i}碰我一下，我就杀了你。

lines.en: : You are aware that {i}you’re{/i} the one pinning {i}me{/i} to the wall, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道{i}“你”{/i}才是把{i}“我”{/i}按在墙上那个吧？

lines.en: : Only because I have no idea what I’d fucking say to her and she was about to look this way.
lines.zh: : 只是因为我完全不知道该跟她说什么，而且她刚才就要往这边看了。

lines.en: : You smell nice.
lines.zh: : 你闻起来挺香。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob12
: Shut the fuck up! I do not!
lines.zh: : 你他妈闭嘴！我才没有！

lines.en: : How long do I need to shut up for?
lines.zh: : 那我要闭多久？

lines.en: : As much as I’d like to spend the entire day in an alleyway with you, I feel like we’re going to need to come out sooner or later.
lines.zh: : 虽然我也想跟你一整天都待在这条巷子里，但我觉得我们迟早还是得出去。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob13
: We need to...I don’t know...figure out a way to distract her or some shit.
lines.zh: : 我们得……我不知道……想个办法把她引开什么的。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob14
: You said the ramen place is right around the corner, right?
lines.zh: : 你说面馆就在拐角处，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. You make the next right and it’s literally the only building there. It’s a dead end right after that.
lines.zh: : 对。下一个路口右转，那儿确实就只有那一栋建筑。再往前就是死路。

lines.en: : Then why don’t you...go and fucking talk to her for a minute or something?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不……过去跟她聊个一分钟什么的？

lines.en: : Just long enough for me to sneak inside and talk to Noodles myself.
lines.zh: : 只要够我溜进去跟 Noodles 谈就行。

lines.en: : Noodles is a bird. You have to-
lines.zh: : Noodles 是只鸟。你得——

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob12
: Can-it with the fucking bird! I mean Tsuneyo!
lines.zh: : 别他妈跟我提鸟了！我说的是 Tsuneyo！

lines.en: : Just go distract my mom or something while I talk to her!
lines.zh: : 你快去把我妈引开什么的，我跟她谈！

lines.en: : ...Okay, deal.
: But if she makes me buy her dinner again, you’re having it taken out of your post-interview allowance.
lines.zh: : 不过要是她又让我请她吃饭，这笔账就从你面试后的零花钱里扣。

lines.en: : Fine! Whatever! Just go!
lines.zh: : 行！随便！快去！

lines.en: scene black
Yumi makes an opening in the alleyway just large enough for me to pass through.
lines.zh: Yumi 在巷口让出一个刚够我挤过去的空隙。

lines.en: My body rubs up against hers and she twitches in response as I move back into the street and over toward her mother...
lines.zh: 我的身体擦过她的身体，她随之颤了一下；我回到街上，朝她母亲走去……

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob15
: Can I help you with-
lines.zh: : 有什么事吗——

lines.en: : Oh, wait a second. You’re that guy.
lines.zh: : 哦，等等。你是那个人。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob16
: Here to buy me dinner again?
lines.zh: : 又来请我吃饭了？

lines.en: menu yumimomchoice:
I am here to distract you
lines.zh: 我是来分散你注意力的

lines.en: : I’m actually here to distract you.
lines.zh: : 其实我是来分散你注意力的。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob17
: Distract me? From what?
lines.zh: : 分散注意力？分散什么？

lines.en: Wait. Shit.
lines.zh: 等等。操。

lines.en: I’m clearly not very good at this.
lines.zh: 我显然不太擅长这个。

lines.en: jump yumimomchoice
Want to make out?
lines.zh: 想接个吻吗？

lines.en: : I think I’m in love with you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我爱上你了。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob17
: Love?
: With me?
lines.zh: : 跟我的？

lines.en: : Are you out of your mind?
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗？

lines.en: : All we did was eat ramen.
lines.zh: : 我们只不过一起吃了碗拉面。

lines.en: : I think we need to kiss for a few minutes in order for me to figure out my true feelings.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们得接几分钟吻，我才能弄清自己真正的感情。

lines.en: : Well, it's cool that you're forward and shit. But I'm gonna have to pass.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这么直接挺好的。不过我还是算了吧。

lines.en: Fuck.
lines.zh: 操。

lines.en: jump yumimomchoice
What are you up to?
lines.zh: 你最近怎么样？

lines.en: : Hey. Just saw you standing here so I thought I’d come and say hi.
lines.zh: : 嘿。刚看到你站在这儿，就想过来打个招呼。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob18
: Oh. Well, uhh...hey.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个，呃……嘿。

lines.en: : I was probably going to get something to eat in a few minutes if you wanted to come.
lines.zh: : 我大概过几分钟要去吃点东西，你要一起吗？

lines.en: A few minutes? Shit.
lines.zh: 几分钟？操。

lines.en: I need to figure out a way to buy more time.
lines.zh: 我得想办法再拖点时间。

lines.en: : What were you planning on eating?
lines.zh: : 你打算吃什么？

lines.en: : Pizza?
lines.zh: : 披萨？

lines.en: : Mexican?
lines.zh: : 墨西哥菜？

lines.en: : Udon?
lines.zh: : 乌冬面？

lines.en: : Well, uhh...The ramen shop is literally right next to us and-
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……拉面店就在我们旁边啊，而且——

lines.en: : Italian?
lines.zh: : 意大利菜？

lines.en: : Crepes?
lines.zh: : 可丽饼？

lines.en: : American?
lines.zh: : 美式菜？

lines.en: : Dessert, maybe?
lines.zh: : 甜点，也许？

lines.en: : Ramen...
lines.zh: : 拉面……

lines.en: : French creole?
lines.zh: : 法式克里奥尔菜？

lines.en: : Pancakes?
lines.zh: : 松饼？

lines.en: : Salad?
lines.zh: : 沙拉？

lines.en: : Fried chicken?
lines.zh: : 炸鸡？

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob19
: Is this some kind of prank or something? Because it’s really fucking weird if it is.
lines.zh: : 这是在恶搞我吗？要是的话，那可真他妈怪。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...inside of Tojo Ramen...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……在 Tojo Ramen 里面……{/i}

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob20
: Good evening. Welcome to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 晚上好。欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : Please take your time looking over the-
lines.zh: : 请您慢慢看——

lines.en: : Actually, I’m not here to eat.
lines.zh: : 其实我不是来吃饭的。

lines.en: : Are you here to rob me?
lines.zh: : 你是来抢劫我的吗？

lines.en: : What? No. I just-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我只是——

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob21
: Listen...We’re in the same class and I really need a job.
lines.zh: : 听着……我们是同班同学，我真的很需要一份工作。

lines.en: : We are?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I’ve never seen you in[school] before.
lines.zh: : 我从没在[school]里见过你。

lines.en: : Yeah you have. We were next to each other in the hallway that one time.
lines.zh: : 你见过。有一次我们在走廊里挨着站。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob22
: But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: : 不过那不是重点。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if you’re looking for any help around here or not, but I promise that if you give me a shot, I’ll work really hard.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你这儿需不需要人手，但我保证，只要你给我个机会，我一定会非常努力地干活。

lines.en: : I might be a little rough around the edges and...I might not have the most experience, but I won’t let you down.
lines.zh: : 我可能有点毛毛躁躁，而且……可能也没什么经验，但我不会让你失望的。

lines.en: : It’s just...kind of tough being self-sufficient at this age.
lines.zh: : 只是……这个年纪要自己养活自己，还挺难的。

lines.en: : Especially when no one wants to give you a chance.
lines.zh: : 尤其是在没人愿意给你机会的时候。

lines.en: : I’m sorry to hear that.
lines.zh: : 听到这些我很遗憾。

lines.en: : We aren’t hiring, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我们不招人。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob23
: Oh...Well, umm...
lines.zh: : 哦……那个，嗯……

lines.en: : There’s...nothing I can do to change your mind?
lines.zh: : 就……没有一点办法能让你改变主意吗？

lines.en: : Not even like, a free...apprenticeship or something?
lines.zh: : 哪怕是免费的……学徒什么的？

lines.en: : Not at the moment. I apologize.
lines.zh: : 目前没有。抱歉。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob24
: Hah...
scene yumiramenjob25
: I love noodles.
lines.zh: : 我爱面条。

lines.en: : Okay. You have my attention.
lines.zh: : 好。你引起我的注意了。

lines.en: : I suppose an apprenticeship would be okay.
lines.zh: : 我想，收个学徒也不是不行。

lines.en: : I do need to test your abilities beforehand, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我得先测试一下你的能力。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob26
: Oh, yeah! Definitely!
lines.zh: : 哦，好！当然！

lines.en: : Just tell me what you need me to do and I’ll try my best!
lines.zh: : 你说要我做什么，我一定尽力！

lines.en: : Like I said, I don’t have a lot of experience, but if it’s something like washing dishes or whatever, I can definitely figure it out.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我没什么经验，不过如果是洗盘子之类的，我肯定能搞定。

lines.en: : Then we will start with something simple.
lines.zh: : 那我们就从简单的开始。

lines.en: : Any time someone enters the store, you must say, “Good evening. Welcome to Tojo Ramen.”
lines.zh: : 只要有客人进店，你就要说：“晚上好。欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。”

lines.en: : Please do that the next time someone walks in.
lines.zh: : 下次有人进来的时候，请照做。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob27
: Easy.
lines.zh: : 简单。

lines.en: : Oh. Here comes someone now.
lines.zh: : 哦。现在正好有人来了。

lines.en: : Please repeat the words directly as I instructed.
lines.zh: : 请一字不差地照我教你的说。

lines.en: : You got it!
lines.zh: : 没问题！

lines.en: : Good evening! And welcome to-
lines.zh: : 晚上好！欢迎光临——

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob28
: Mom?
: Close, but not quite.
lines.zh: : 接近了，但还差一点。

lines.en: : Perhaps it would be better if you worked somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 也许你去别的地方工作会更好。

lines.en: : Yumi?...
lines.zh: : Yumi？……

lines.en: : What are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : Do you work here now?
lines.zh: : 你现在在这儿打工吗？

lines.en: : No, I-
: I was just leaving.
lines.zh: : 我正要走。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob29
Yumi immediately leaves Tsuneyo’s side and walks right past her mother, barely acknowledging her along the way.
lines.zh: Yumi 立刻离开 Tsuneyo 身边，径直从她母亲身旁走过，一路上几乎没看她一眼。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob30
Yumi’s mother remains silent for a moment before looking at me.
lines.zh: Yumi 的母亲沉默了片刻，然后看向我。

lines.en: Even Tsuneyo seems to understand that something is going on since she’s yet to welcome me to the store.
lines.zh: 连 Tsuneyo 似乎都察觉到事情不对劲，因为她到现在都还没欢迎我进店。

lines.en: : So that’s what you were trying to distract me from...
lines.zh: : 所以那就是你刚才想引开我注意力的原因啊……

lines.en: : She didn’t seem like she wanted to see you.
lines.zh: : 她看起来不太想见你。

lines.en: : I don’t blame her...
lines.zh: : 我不怪她……

lines.en: : The fuck are you supposed to be, though? Boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 不过你算她什么人？男朋友？

lines.en: : You seem a little old.
lines.zh: : 你看起来有点老。

lines.en: : Her teacher. I’m helping her look for a job.
lines.zh: : 她的老师。我在帮她找工作。

lines.en: I conveniently leave out the fact that I have forcefully made out with her daughter before.
lines.zh: 我很顺手地省略了自己曾经强行吻过她女儿这件事。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob31
: A job, huh?...
lines.zh: : 工作啊？……

lines.en: : Well...that’s good...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那挺好的……

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob30
: Haven’t given you my name yet, have I?
lines.zh: : 我还没告诉你我的名字吧？

lines.en: : You have not.
lines.zh: : 是没有。

lines.en: : I’m Yuki. Yumi’s mother.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Yuki。Yumi 的母亲。

lines.en: : And you should probably chase after her now. She’s sensitive.
lines.zh: : 你现在大概该去追她了。她很敏感。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll go find her.
lines.zh: : 好。我去找她。

lines.en: : And I’ll see you some other time.
lines.zh: : 那我们改天见。

lines.en: scene yumiramenjob31
: Yup...
: See you around...
lines.zh: : 回头见……

lines.en: scene black
I’m not able to find Yumi after that.
lines.zh: 之后我没能找到 Yumi。

lines.en: Granted, I don’t look for very long.
lines.zh: 当然，我也没找很久。

lines.en: While it would have been nice to find her, I can’t foresee anything good happening if I’m wandering around the second half of town in the dark.
lines.zh: 虽然能找到她当然好，但大半夜在城的后半区乱逛，我想象不出会有什么好结果。

lines.en: I’m sure that wherever she went, though, she’s fine.
lines.zh: 不过我相信，不管她去了哪儿，她都没事。

lines.en: She probably just needs a little time to cool off.
lines.zh: 她大概只是需要点时间冷静一下。

lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}
